scope: Focused follow-up on the two controls with increases above five percent in the complete 52-fixture comparison, plus the earlier small-reciprocal and single-root reciprocal-cache controls. Twenty-seven fresh repetitions per executable and fixture, in alternating order, with identical fixed-CPU preparation, query inputs, iteration counts, caps, outputs and checksums. All earlier complete/unpaired measurements remain retained. This supplements them; it is neither a new complete 52-fixture run nor evidence of a universal speedup.
